source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Identify the lake mentioned in the Pithapuram inscription of Velanati Prithviswara?
x: Prithviswara, the last Velanati king, faced the Kakatiya invasion led by Ganapatideva's general Mutyala Chaunda Rayudu. The Pithapuram inscription (1186) mentions the present-day Kolleru lake.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Raichur Antarvedi is formed by the confluence of which rivers?
x: The triangular area between the Krishna and Tungabhadra rivers is called the Raichur Antarvedi or Raichur Doab. Supremacy over it led to many wars between Vijayanagara and the Bahmani Sultans.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Which of the following is a Palaeolithic site?
x: Billasurgam in Kurnool district is a Palaeolithic settlement. A Neolithic copper settlement was found at Keesarapally and menhirs at Reverala.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Which of the following is evidence of Copper Age in Andhra?
x: Painted clay vessels of the Copper Age have been found at Pathapadu in Kurnool district.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: In which literature Andhras are referred to as 'Andhakaratta'?
x: Andhras are mentioned in ancient Buddhist literature (600-400 BC), which refers to Andhradesa as 'Andhakaratta'.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: According to the Macedonian inscription, who among the following said that the Satavahanas belong to Bellari?
x: The Myakadoni inscription of Pulomavi-III and the Hirahadagalli inscription of Pallava Sivaskandavarma support the argument that the Satavahanas belonged to Bellari. V.V. Mirashi proposed Vidarbha as their birthplace.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: What was the name of the capital of the place 'Anupa' ruled by Gautamiputra Satakarni?
x: The Raghuvamsa states that Mahishmati, on the river Rewa (Narmada), is the capital of Anupa Desha, one of the kingdoms conquered by Gautamiputra Satakarni.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Who among the following issued the Junnar Edict?
x: The Junnar inscription mentions the guilds of Dhannuka (grain), Kasakara (bronze work) and Tesakara (polish work).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Identify the inscription of Chanda Satakarni?
x: Chanda Sri Satakarni issued the inscription at Kodavali village near Pithapuram in East Godavari district.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Which Ikshvaku emperor is described as 'Sri Parvatadhipati'?
x: Veera Purushadatta was known as 'Sri Parvatadhipati' and the 'Ashoka of the South'; Andhradesa became a Buddhist land in his time.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Which of the following inscriptions was given by Rudrapurushadatta?
x: Inscriptions of Rudrapurushadatta, the last Ikshvaku king, were found at Gurajala and the Nagarjuna hills.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: An inscription from which region mentions multiple donations made by the emperor to various communities and institutions?
x: According to the Allur inscription of the Satavahana period, the Buddhist community received bullock carts as a gift.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Which inscription mentions that Rishabhadatta deposited 2,000 Karshapanas in a line of weavers belonging to Govardhana?
x: The Nasik inscription records that Shaka Kshatrapa Rishabhadatta deposited a perpetual fund of 2000 karshapanas with the Kolika (weavers') guild of Govardhana.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Which of the following texts contains contributions by women?
x: Hala's Gathasaptasati describes the condition of women in Satavahana society, and some of its verses were written by women poets.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p32
s: Who wrote the book 'Yogasara'?
x: Nagarjunacharya, a Mahayana Buddhist, wrote about 24 texts in Sanskrit, including Arogyamanjari, Suhrillekha, Rasaratnakaram and Yogasara.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who was the Eastern Chalukya king who issued the Inscription of Vipparla?
x: The Vipparla inscription of Jayasimha Vallabha-I (641 AD) is the first Telugu inscription of the Eastern Chalukyas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who among the following kings have the title 'Tripura Martya Maheswara'?
x: Gunaga Vijayaditya conquered Nellore, Kiranapuram and Achalapuram in his Dahala campaign and assumed the title Tripuramartya Maheswara.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: During the Eastern Chalukya period Potla Cheruvu was a famous center for?
x: Potla Cheruvu (Patancheru), Kolanupaka and Vardhamanapuram were Jain centres. There were 500 Jain vasadis in Potlacheruvu alone.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Identify the person who was gifted village Nandampudi by Rajaraja Narendra?
x: Narayana Bhattu, who helped Nannayya in writing the Andhra Mahabharata, was given the village Nandampudi in 1051 AD.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: For the first time In which inscription the Kakatiyas were mentioned?
x: The Kakatiyas were first mentioned in the Magallu inscription, which names Kakartya Gundyana as their progenitor. It states that the Kakatiyas were feudatories of the Rashtrakutas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Kakatiyas were feudatories of which Andhra dynasty?
x: According to the Magallu inscription, the Kakatiyas were feudatories of the Rashtrakutas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who defeated Ganapatideva in 1263?
x: The only battle Ganapatideva lost was the Battle of Muthukur (1263 AD) against the Pandya king Jatavarma Sundara Pandya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who among the following bears the title 'Rayagajakesari'?
x: Rudramadevi defeated the Seuna king Mahadeva and drove him to Devagiri, earning the title 'Rayagajakesari', which appears in her Bidar inscription.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: In which district the term 'Tambaya Danamu' is found in the Buddhist settlement?
x: The Buddhist site of Kothur, on the Sharada river near Elamanchili in Visakhapatnam district, records the term Tambaya Dana.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: The history of early Satavahanas is not mentioned in this book?
x: Hala's Gathasaptasati is a Prakrit collection of 700 verses on rural life. Kathasaritsagaram, Dwatrimsat Puthalika and Pratisthanapurakalpa describe the origin of the Satavahanas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who among the following authored the book 'Jinendra Kalyanabhyudayamu'?
x: The Jain Appayacharya of Prataparudra's court wrote 'Jinendra Kalyanabhyudaya'.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who are said to have written 'Andhrashabda Chintamani'?
x: Andhrasabda Chintamani, a Sanskrit text on Telugu grammar also called Andhra Bhashanushasanam, was written by Nannaya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Rekapalli was the capital of which dynasty?
x: Musunuri Prolaya Nayaka, founder of the Musunuri Nayaka kingdom, defeated the Turks and ruled from Rekapalli near Malyavanta in the Godavari region.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who was the Reddy king who had the title 'Rachuru Durga Vibhala'?
x: Prolaya Vemareddy chased the Muslims from western Andhra and took titles like 'Gujjuri Dattu Vibhala', 'Aneyamandalika Gandara' and 'Rachuru Durga Vibhala'.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who wrote the book 'Narasimha Puranam'?
x: Errana, court poet of Prolaya Vemareddy, wrote Harivamsa and Nrisimha Purana. He completed the Aranya Parva of the Mahabharata and is one of the Kavitrayam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who among the following authored the book 'A Forgotten Empire'?
x: Robert Sewell, an employee of the Madras Presidency, wrote 'A Forgotten Empire: Vijayanagar', which also describes the battle of Rakshasi Tangadi.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: During Vijayanagara period 'Vipra Vinodinis' were part of?
x: Vipras are Brahmins; a section of Brahmins who entertained people with juggling acts was called Vipravinodis.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p33
s: Who mentions the practice of Sati in Vijayanagaram?
x: Nicolo Conti mentioned sati (sahagamanam), polygamy and the festivals of Diwali and Shivaratri. He wrote that hundreds of the king's wives were willing to sacrifice their lives.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Who wrote the book 'Varadambika Parinayam'?
x: Tirumalamba, of Achyutaraya's time, wrote the Sanskrit work 'Varadambika Parinayam' on the marriage of Achyutaraya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Where is a famous large stone bull of Vijayanagara period?
x: Penugonda Virupanna, a servant of Achyutaraya, built the Veerabhadra temple at Lepakshi, which has a very large Basavanna (Nandi) sculpture.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: At which place in Andhra Pradesh did the Dutch East India Trading Association set up its first factory?
x: The Dutch set up their first base in Andhra at Machilipatnam in 1605 with the permission of the Golkonda Sultan. A second base was set up at Pulicat in 1610.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: What is the name of Rajahmundry Sub Collector who started schools in Anglo-Vernacular languages in most parts of Andhra?
x: Rajahmundry Sub Collector G.N. Taylor started Anglo-Vernacular schools in the Andhra region.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: In which year was the American Baptist Mission established in Andhra?
x: The American Baptist Mission was established at Ongole in 1866. The first Christian mission in Andhra was the London Missionary Society at Jammalamadugu (1805).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Who among the following founded the Madras Native Association?
x: Gajula Lakshminarasu Chetty started the magazine 'Crescent' in 1844 and founded the Madras Native Association in 1852.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Which of the following magazine was started by Veeresalingam?
x: Veeresalingam's magazines included Vivekavardhini (1874), Hasya Sanjeevini (1876), Satihita Bodhini (1883), Satyasamvardhini (1891) and Telugu Janana (1904).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: In which year Veeresalingam performed the first widow remarriage?
x: Veeresalingam performed the first widow remarriage in Andhra on 11 December 1881 at his house in Rajahmundry.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: In which region in 1879 the people rebelled against the English for their forest laws?
x: Influenced by the Rampa movement, the Rekapalli tribes rebelled against the British on 10 July 1879 under Ambul Reddy over the increased tax on podu farming.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Which organization played an active role in Bipin Chandrapal's visit to Rajahmundry?
x: The Balabharati Samiti, formed in Rajahmundry on 11 February 1907 by youths like Ganti Lakshmanna and Tanguturi Sriramulu, played an active role in Bipin Chandrapal's visit.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Who among the following was the Principal of Rajahmundry Training College in 1907?
x: Mark Hunter, Principal at Rajahmundry in 1907, ordered students to remove Vande Mataram badges after Bipin Chandrapal's lectures. Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao was expelled for refusing.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Identify the President of the National College established in 1910 at Machilipatnam?
x: The Bandar National College at Machilipatnam started on 27 March 1910 under the presidency of Konda Venkatappaiah, with Kopalli Hanumantha Rao as principal.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Which newspaper strongly supported the Home Rule Movement in Andhra?
x: Deshamata, Hitakarini and Krishnapatrika propagated the Home Rule movement. Deshamata was founded by Chilakamarthi Lakshminarasimham.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Who among the following went to study the effect of the movement against forest laws in Palnadu region in July, 1921?
x: During the Palnadu Pullari Satyagraha (1921), the Andhra Congress Committee sent Unnava Lakshminarayana and Vedantam Narasimhacharya to assess the situation; both were arrested.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: How many seats did the Justice Party win in the Madras Legislative Assembly elections of 1920?
x: In the 1920 elections the Justice Party won 63 of 98 seats and formed the government in Madras Presidency, with Subbarayalu Reddiar as Chief Minister.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p34
s: Identify the person who has been appointed as Dictator to organize Salt Satyagraha in Andhra?
x: Konda Venkatappaiah was the Dictator of the Salt Satyagraha in Andhra, which started first at Machilipatnam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: Who among the following authored the novel "Asamardhuni Jeevayatra"?
x: Tripuraneni Gopichand's 'Asamarthuni Jivayatra' was the first psychological novel in Telugu literature.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: In which year did the Socialist Party establish its Andhra branch?
x: Young Congressmen inclined to Marxism met at Vijayawada on 28 June 1934 and formed the Andhra Socialist Party, with N.G. Ranga as its first president.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: Who among the following from Guntur has written many articles on "Telugu Prajala Prasthuta paristhiti" in Hindu magazine?
x: In 1911 six articles titled 'Telugu Vari neti paristhiti' were published in the Hindu Patrika, written by Jonnavittula Gurunatham.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: A Telugu magazine commented that "Telugu culture has no protection unless there is a government of its own".
x: Desabhimani, founded by Devaguptam Seshachalapathy Rao and published from Vijayawada, sensitized Telugu people to the need for a separate Andhra state.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: Who presided over the first Andhra Mahasabha held at Bapatla in 1913 and opposed the idea of a separate Andhra state?
x: The first Andhra Mahasabha was held on 26 May 1913 at Bapatla under the chairmanship of Bayya Narasimheswara Sharma, who said 'first we are Indians and then Andhras'.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: In which year did B.N. Sharma moved the resolution.
x: On 6 February 1918, B.N. Sharma introduced a resolution in the Central Legislature for a separate Andhra state.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: Who among the following opposed a separate Andhra state when he became the Chief Minister of Madras State in 1932?
x: When the Bobbili Raja became Chief Minister of Madras in 1932, he opposed the proposal of a separate Andhra state.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: The Rayalaseema Mahasabha held in which region in 1935 passed a resolution opposing the formation of a separate Andhra state.
x: In September 1935 the second meeting of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha at Kadapa, chaired by T.N. Ramakrishna Reddy, passed a resolution against a separate Andhra state.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: In 1937, the agreement between Andhra and Rayalaseema leaders was made at Kashinathuni Nageswara Rao house. It is known as Sribagh Agreement. Where is Sribagh?
x: On 16 November 1937, Andhra and Rayalaseema leaders met at Kashinadhuni Nageswara Rao's residence 'Sri Bagh' in Madras to protect the interests of Rayalaseema.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: A commission in its report opined that the creation of linguistic states in 1948 posed a threat to national unity and integrity.
x: The Dhar Commission, appointed on 17 June 1948 under S.K. Dhar, reported on 10 December 1948 that linguistic states were detrimental to national unity and integrity.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: Who among the following worked with Gandhi for some time at the Sabarmati Ashram?
x: Potti Sriramulu joined Gandhi's Sabarmati Ashram after the death of his family and took part in the Salt Satyagraha and Quit India movement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: In the second Visalandhra Mahasabha held at Hyderabad in 1954, who among the following strongly Supported for Visalandhra?
x: At the second Visalandhra Mahasabha in Hyderabad (13-14 June 1954), Swami Ramananda Tirtha opposed a separate Telangana and strengthened the Visalandhra movement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: On which date in 1953 the Government of India appointed the States Reorganization Commission.
x: The Central Government appointed the States Reorganisation Commission under Fazal Ali on 22 December 1953. It submitted its report on 30 September 1955.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p35
s: In which year B. Ramakrishna Rao, a staunch supporter of Telangana state and the Chief Minister of Hyderabad, changed his stance and suggested merging Telangana and Andhra as soon as possible.
x: Hyderabad Chief Minister Burgula Ramakrishna Rao, at a meeting of Chief Ministers in New Delhi on 22 October 1955, approved Visalandhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: Who founded the Varthamana Vyavaharikandhra Bhasha Parivartaka Samaj?
x: Kandukuri Veeresalingam as President and Gidugu Ramamurthy as Secretary founded the 'Vartamanandhra Bhasha Parivartaka Samaj'.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: Year of establishment of 'Andhra Pradesh Sahitya Akademi'
x: The Andhra Pradesh Sahitya Akademi was established in 1957 as an affiliate of the Kendra Sahitya Akademi (1954).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: Rabindhra Bharati, a cultural institution built in Hyderabad to mark the centenary of Tagore was started by whom in 1961.
x: The foundation stone of Rabindra Bharati was laid on 23 March 1960 in Hyderabad, and it was launched on 11 May 1961 by Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: In which year the Government of Andhra Pradesh declared Telugu as the official language.
x: The Andhra Pradesh Official Language Act was enacted in 1966, when Kasu Brahmananda Reddy was Chief Minister.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: Period of Srikakulam armed struggle?
x: Inspired by the Naxalbari movement, the Srikakulam armed struggle of the tribals raged between 1968 and 1970.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet passed the Land Reforms Bill under the leadership of whom among the following?
x: During his tenure as Chief Minister (1971-73), P.V. Narasimha Rao introduced the Land Ceiling Act.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: In which year the World Telugu Mahasabha was organized for the first time to promote Telugu language, literature and culture.
x: The first World Telugu Conference was held from 12 to 18 April 1975 at Lal Bahadur Stadium, Hyderabad.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: Chief Minister N.T Rama Rao launched a new system called 'Dharma Mahamatra' to eradicate corruption from the government. Who was the first officer to hold this post?
x: N.T. Rama Rao created the post of Dharma Mahamatra to stamp out corruption among higher officials, and Ramireddy was appointed to it.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: In which region in 1991 did women start antisara movement?
x: The anti-Sara (anti-arrack) movement started in Dubagunta village of Nellore district, led by Roshamma.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: Who among the following authored 'Nallapoddu', a collection of Dalit essays?
x: Gogu Shyamala collected the writings of Dalit women and compiled them in 2003 as 'Nallapoddu'.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: Whose original name was Satthiraja Lakshminarayana among the following painters?
x: Cartoonist, painter and film director Bapu's original name was Satthiraju Venkata Lakshminarayana.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p36
s: In his famous work, which animal/bird did Joshua use to send a message to God for a hungry, poor Dalit?
x: In Gurram Joshua's 'Gabbilam' (1941), the Dalit protagonist sends his message to Kashi Vishwanatha through a bat. Joshua is considered the first Telugu Dalit poet.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p50
s: Assaka is the capital of the people?
x: The Suttanipata mentions the Andhaka states Assaka and Mulaka on both sides of the Godavari. Paudanyapura, the capital of Assaka, is present-day Bodhan in Telangana.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p50
s: Center of Rajagirika Buddhist doctrine?
x: Among the branches of Chaityaka Buddhism, Rajagirika was centred at Guntupalli (West Godavari). Uttarashaila was at Jaggayyapet, Aparashaila at Sriparvatam and Siddharthika at Gudivada.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p50
s: Which Chinese traveler wrote that he saw students memorizing "Suhrlekha" in India?
x: Suhrllekha (Letter to a Friend) was written by Acharya Nagarjuna and dedicated to Yajnashri Satakarni.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p50
s: Which number cave in Ajanta has "Svetagaja Jataka painting"?
x: Caves 9 and 10 at Ajanta belong to the Satavahana period. The Shweta Gaja Jataka painting is in Cave 10.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p50
s: In the Satavahanas time the Guild Padhika belongs to?
x: Satavahana inscriptions mention 18 types of handicraft guilds. Padhika were carpenters.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p50
s: Upasika Bodhishri rendered outstanding service to the propagation of Buddhism during his reign?
x: Upasika Bodhishri lived during the reign of the Ikshvaku king Veerapurushadatta and built a chaitya and a Chatusshala at Chuladhamma Giri in Sriparvatam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p50
s: Gunaga Vijayaditya assumed the title "Tripura-Martya-Mahesvara" to mark the victory of which of these cities?
x: In his Dahala campaign, Gunaga Vijayaditya conquered Nellore, Kiranapuram and Achalapuram and took the title Tripuramartya Maheswara.
